findings.summary: The hidden status renders Listing Optimization / SEO as a heading instead of a link, so users cannot navigate to its canonical route or receive its current-page indication.
findings.fix: Set this parent item to status: "live" so Sidebar renders its native link with exact-path aria-current; update sidebar.test.tsx to verify the parent link at /catalog/seo and that nested Tools and Buyer Preview remain distinct links and alone become current on their routes.
findings.evidence: href: "/catalog/seo", status: "hidden"; the test expects a non-clickable heading.

passed: Sidebar uses a named native navigation landmark and native links; decorative icons are hidden from assistive technology.
aria-current is applied only when the pathname exactly matches the link destination.
notes: This was the pre-implementation review. NAV-001 was addressed by making the parent a canonical live link and adding tests for parent and child active-route states.
